baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُعْرَضُونَ, paired غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا, and the shift وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ... أَدْخِلُوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A paired daily cadence governs repeated exposure to a visibly kindled fire; the singular grave day then interrupts that cadence with resurrection and commanded entry. The syntax therefore stages punishment across a recurring phase and a decisive threshold rather than describing one undifferentiated event.

activation_trace.role: A kindled fire supplies the concrete object that persists across both temporal phases.
Presentation into view makes the first phase repeated confrontation rather than yet explicit entry.
First-day departure fixes one edge of the recurring daily interval.
The evening interval closes the paired daily cycle.
A day understood as a grave event marks the rupture from recurrence to culmination.
The rising of the Hour supplies the resurrection threshold at which the scene changes.
Movement into an interior gives the culminating command a spatial finality absent from mere exposure.
Concentrated force grades the destination as the punishment's maximum phase.
Painful penalty identifies the whole sequence as punitive rather than merely spectacular.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts a single continuous scene of people burning in the fire.
changed_reading.after: The verse distinguishes a recurrent regime of compelled exposure from a singular resurrection-day transfer into the punishment's severest interior.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ in the plural command أَدْخِلُوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The house is not only a biological plural. Its primary branch defines people by reciprocal return to a principal, while the split-root inventory adds uninterrupted succession and allegiance. The plural command moves this attached retinue as a corporate body into the final destination.

activation_trace.role: Those who return to a man and to whom he returns supply the household's reciprocal corporate bond.
The non-dominant mapped root contributes linked succession, making the house legible as an attached train of followers.
Causative entry acts on the affiliated plurality as one destination-bound body.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh's family is named as a simple genealogical group.
changed_reading.after: Pharaoh's house is a reciprocal affiliation structure, a linked retinue gathered under his principal identity and transferred corporately.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early prayer asks protection from punishment and causative entry into gardens for a righteous household spanning fathers and spouses. The focus reuses causative entry, a household expression, and punishment with the destination reversed. Pharaoh's house thus becomes a negative counterpart to the admitted righteous household.

activation_trace.role: The focus command supplies the punitive side of the mirrored movement into a destination.
Reciprocal household attachment supplies the corporate object of the reversed admission.
The prayer names painful penalty as what the believing group seeks to have warded off.
Causative movement into gardens provides the positive admission pattern reversed by the focus.
Paternal relation broadens the admitted unit beyond isolated individuals.
Marital pairing completes the positive household structure against which Pharaoh's house is read.

structural_cues: 40:7-8 joins protection from punishment to causative garden-entry and a coordinated list of righteous relations; 40:46 recombines entry, house, and punishment with the destination reversed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated entry root, explicit family relations, and opposite outcomes; I infer a deliberate counter-admission, while ordinary reuse of destination language remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The house is merely a collective recipient of a punitive command.
changed_reading.after: Its admission is the anti-garden household admission: corporate attachment to Pharaoh has become the negative counterpart of a household joined by righteousness.

context_deltas.mechanism: A believer is introduced from Pharaoh's house, then divine protection pushes away the plotted harms from him just before bad punishment closes around Pharaoh's house. The focus's collective label therefore follows a narrated subtraction: household proximity alone does not determine the destination, and protected dissent can sever operative affiliation.

activation_trace.role: The focus household branch supplies the collective whose apparent inclusiveness the preceding narrative qualifies.
The same reciprocal-house relation locates a concealed believer inside Pharaoh's social household.
Protective deflection removes the believer from the harms generated by the house.
Descending evil that closes around its target marks the collective fate from which protection has separated him.
The repeated house label places the punished collective directly beside the separately protected member.
Painful penalty supplies the immediate antecedent to the focus's more detailed punishment regime.

structural_cues: 40:28 identifies the concealed believer as from Pharaoh's house; 40:45 contrasts singular protection with punishment enclosing Pharaoh's house immediately before 40:46.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies membership, singular protection, and the adjacent collective fate; I infer that active allegiance, not bare proximity or genealogy, controls inclusion, while an ellipsis that simply excludes the believer without redefining the house remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Pharaoh's house is a genealogically exhaustive block.
changed_reading.after: The command reaches the Pharaoh-affiliated collective after the narrative has carved out a protected dissenter from within its social perimeter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, all emerge into the open, nothing remains hidden, and each self receives its recompense. Later, witnesses stand. These public and judicial cues turn repeated presentation before fire into anticipatory exposure, culminating when the Hour and the witnesses stand and the entry command functions like sentence execution.

activation_trace.role: Presentation for sight anchors the focus in public exposure rather than hidden suffering.
Resurrection-standing supplies the focus's culminating judicial threshold.
Emergence and uncovering supply the public field in which persons become exposed.
The impossibility of remaining covered removes concealment from the judgment scene.
Action answered by its due consequence gives exposure a judicial result.
The witnesses' bodily standing echoes the Hour's rising with an assembled court.
Presence joined to witnessing supplies observers who make the final exposure evidentiary.

structural_cues: 40:16-17 orders open emergence, total disclosure, and recompense; 40:51 repeats standing with the witnesses after 40:46 makes the Hour stand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public emergence, non-concealment, recompense, and standing witnesses; I infer an arraignment-to-sentence mechanism, while a non-forensic spectacle remains a materially live alternative.

changed_reading.before: They are periodically shown the fire as a private torment.
changed_reading.after: Their repeated exposure anticipates a public reckoning; when the Hour and witnesses stand, commanded entry executes the disclosed judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same evening-and-early-day hinge is assigned to praise, while night and opened daylight are made for repose and sight. The focus occupies those recurring hinges with compulsory fire-exposure. Its schedule can therefore be heard as an inverted daily observance and a deprivation of the temporal mercy otherwise built into the day.

activation_trace.role: First-day movement supplies one recurring hinge of the punitive schedule.
Evening supplies the other hinge, making the focus cadence comparable to the later praise cadence.
The same evening interval becomes an appointed time of praise in the contrasting routine.
The beginning of day pairs with evening and supplies the positive cadence's morning edge.
Night's darkness supplies the broader daily interval whose humane purpose is then stated.
Cessation of movement makes night a provision of repose that the punitive cycle withholds.
Day opening into light supplies the merciful counterpart to morning fire-exposure.
Ordinary sight in daylight contrasts with being made to confront the fire visually.

structural_cues: 40:55 pairs evening with early morning for praise, and 40:61 assigns repose and visibility to the night-day alternation; 40:46 uses the same daily hinges for exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel time pairs and stated daily functions; I infer an intentionally inverted observance and deprivation, while conventional merism for continual action remains the simpler alternative.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening merely mean that the exposure happens repeatedly.
changed_reading.after: The repeated exposure is an anti-observance occupying the day's devotional hinges and reversing the repose and visibility otherwise granted by daily time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inside the fire, followers appeal first to their arrogant leaders for a share to be absorbed, then all appeal to the keepers for one day of lightening. Both delegation and respite fail. The focus's morning-evening cadence thus measures an untransferable liability whose smallest imaginable break is explicitly denied.

activation_trace.role: The morning edge begins each unit of the recurring liability.
The evening edge closes each unit without supplying relief.
A consequence that adheres to followers explains why prior dependence becomes shared but nontransferable liability.
Claimed greatness identifies the former leaders to whom the dependents unsuccessfully delegate a portion.
Reduction of a burden supplies the precise respite requested and refused.
One bounded day becomes the minimal unit of desired interruption.
Painful penalty is the burden from which even one day's reduction is sought.

structural_cues: 40:47-48 dissolves leader-follower delegation inside the fire; 40:49-50 narrows the request to one day and answers it with failed invocation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the recurring pair, the request for one day, and two failed transfers of relief; I infer that the cadence dramatizes uninterrupted personal liability, while the petition can also be read as later dialogue without backward effect on the pair.

changed_reading.before: Morning and evening are neutral calendar markers for repetition.
changed_reading.after: They count a burden that cannot be shifted to leaders and will not be lightened even for one bounded day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence supplies restraints, linked chains, dragging through boiling liquid, a stoked fire, then gate-entry and abiding. Read back into the focus, presentation and entry are distinct stations on a coerced trajectory: confrontation, conveyance, threshold crossing, and fixed residence.

activation_trace.role: Presentation into view anchors the trajectory's initial station of confrontation.
Movement into an interior anchors the later station as an actual threshold crossing.
A restraint fastening the body supplies coercion at the start of the later procession.
Connected links make the restrained group mechanically conveyable as a sequence.
Dragging and extension supply the directional motion between punitive stations.
The same kindled fire reconnects the later conveyance sequence to the focus object.
Ignition and agitation present the fire as an actively prepared station rather than inert scenery.
The later entry command repeats the focus movement and confirms an interior destination.
An explicit entrance materializes the boundary implicit in the focus's causative entry.
Persistence resistant to ending turns threshold crossing into fixed residence.

structural_cues: 40:71-72 orders restraint, dragging, heated liquid, and stoked fire; 40:76 ends the sequence with an entry command, gates, and abiding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered motion and repeated fire and entry roots; I infer one spatial trajectory that clarifies the focus's two verbs, while separate reiterative punishment scenes remain a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Presentation and entry are two near-synonyms for being punished by fire.
changed_reading.after: They mark distinct stations in a forced procession from visible confrontation, through conveyance, to gated and enduring interior confinement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, signs are repeatedly made visible yet denied; once punishment is actually seen, professed belief no longer benefits. The focus's presentation before fire thus has an epistemic edge: what was refused as a sign becomes unavoidable sight, but disclosure now exposes rather than rescues.

activation_trace.role: Presentation for sight anchors the focus as a compelled visual disclosure.
Making signs appear supplies the prior offered disclosure against which forced exposure is measured.
Failure of recognition names the response that turns later sight into belated disclosure.
Direct visual apprehension of punishment supplies the moment denial collapses.
The explicit absence of benefit closes the possibility that late recognition can rescue.
Repeated direct seeing confirms that terminal knowledge is visually forced.

structural_cues: 40:81 joins divine showing to human nonrecognition; 40:84-85 joins seeing punishment to a belief that can no longer benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies offered visibility, denial, forced sight, and lost benefit; I infer that the fire-presentation functions as terminal disclosure, while its primary function can remain punitive rather than pedagogical.

changed_reading.before: Being presented to the fire adds only sensory torment.
changed_reading.after: It is also coerced recognition: the denied reality is finally made undeniable at the stage when seeing can expose guilt but cannot reverse the outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice recalls peoples stronger in gathered force and more enduring in traces, yet taken, and it places severe penalty beside that failure. The focus's superlative severity answers their comparative strength: human power and material residue are not merely overcome but become the scale against which punitive force is revalued.

activation_trace.role: Concentrated force in the superlative anchors the focus's answer to prior claims of strength.
Comparative hardness and power establish the human scale later overturned.
Strength gathered like rope-strands presents predecessor power as materially compounded.
A surviving mark gives that power durable visible residue in the land.
Severe divine penalty immediately converts the language of strength into its punitive counterforce.
The repeated comparative formula closes the surah-long frame around Pharaoh's apparent power.
Compounded human force is repeated at the frame's close and again shown unable to avail.
Enduring traces repeat the material evidence that nevertheless fails to preserve its makers.

structural_cues: 40:21-22 and 40:82 repeat stronger force and greater traces around the Pharaoh narrative, while 40:46 gives punishment the superlative of the same strength root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated comparative frame and shared strength root; I infer a deliberate revaluation in the focus superlative, while independent warnings about vanished nations remain an alternative.

changed_reading.before: Severest punishment is only an absolute statement of pain intensity.
changed_reading.after: Its superlative also answers the surah's failed human strength, converting Pharaoh's scale of power into the measure of his house's defeat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates night-travel and distant-fire side branches rather than the ordinary time senses. It remains anchored in fire, presentation for sight, and evening, and it explains their co-occurrence as forced orientation. Downstream prose should mark it as an imagistic possibility, not replace the direct punishment reading.

activation_trace.role: A fire perceived from afar supplies a visible point toward which attention can be compelled.
Making something visible turns the fire into an imposed object of orientation.
The night traveler who aims toward fire supplies the ordinary guidance-image that the punitive scene reverses.

changed_reading.before: Evening is only the second endpoint of a time merism.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the condemned are made into anti-travelers repeatedly oriented toward a fire-beacon that announces confinement rather than guidance or shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the direct phrase denotes maximum painful penalty, not a technical compound of fastening and abstention. It remains anchored in both focus roots and gains material support from the denied lightening and later restraints. Downstream prose should retain the ordinary degree sense and present this only as a secondary texture of total constraint.

activation_trace.role: Tightening a bond recasts severity as maximal fastening and non-release.
Withholding and preventing supplies deprivation as a secondary texture of punishment.
Requested but unavailable lightening supports the image of a burden kept fully tightened.
A bodily fastening later materializes the constraint latent in the severity side branch.
Connected links make total constraint concrete and continuous.

changed_reading.before: The superlative communicates only the highest degree of pain.
changed_reading.after: As a contained secondary image, it is the punishment kept maximally tight: release, relief, and abstention from suffering are all withheld.

strongest_changes: The two focus clauses form a temporal and spatial sequence: recurrent exposure gives way to resurrection-day entry.
The garden-entry prayer and its righteous family list make Pharaoh's house a reversed household admission.
The protected believer inside Pharaoh's house prevents the collective label from being read as mechanically genealogical.
Later denied relief and the chain-to-gate procession turn the daily cadence into uninterruptible liability moving toward permanent confinement.
Public emergence, standing witnesses, and belated sight make presentation to the fire both judicial exposure and terminal disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly returned the focus's exact mechanisms in transformed settings: household entry first appeared as a prayer, the house contained a protected dissenter, daily hinge-times carried praise and repose, standing became witness assembly, and later motion supplied chains, dragging, gates, and abiding. These recurrences changed a static torment statement into a differentiated social, temporal, judicial, and spatial process.
remaining_uncertainties: The morning-evening phrase may be a conventional totalizing merism rather than a contrast with the later praise schedule.
The believer's description as from Pharaoh's house does not by itself decide whether the final house-label is genealogical, political, or allegiance-based.
The later chain-and-gate sequence may reiterate punishment scenes rather than map a single continuous route back onto the focus.
The anti-beacon and tightened-withholding readings depend on visibly anchored but non-primary branch images and should remain exploratory.
